Allah swears by this city, Makkah.
And you, Prophet, live in this city.
And by a father and his children.
We made people to work hard and face hard things in this life.
Does he think no one has power over him?
He says: I spent so much money!
Does he think no one saw him?
Did We not give him two eyes?
And a tongue and two lips?
And show him the two ways, the good way and the bad way?
But he did not try to climb the steep hill.
What can make you know what the steep hill is?
It is to free a slave.
Or to feed people on a day of hunger.
To feed a child with no parents who is a relative.
Or a poor person who has nothing.
And then to be one of those who believe, and who tell each other to be patient and kind.
They are the people of the right side.
But people who said no to Our signs are the people of the left side.
Fire will be closed over them.
